dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, scalloped perimeters of high-intensity pixels forming 'C' and 'O' shaped enclosures around low-intensity centers; edges exhibit a jagged, non-linear transition with frequent pixel-level breaks in the boundary continuity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous, solid high-intensity clusters concentrated in the anterior and mid-dorsal regions; these clusters lack internal gradients and serve as junctions between interlocking macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five largest macro-annuli form an irregular, elongated pentagonal network across the dorsal-lateral plane, with specific tight clustering observed in the mid-body region.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive jigsaw-like mosaic pattern covering the full visible dorsal surface, characterized by high-frequency interlocking of high and low intensity tonal regions.
